A '''historian''' was an individual that researched [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history. [[Wolam Tser]], [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] and [[Ashur Sungazer]] were examples of prominent historians in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Some historians, especially ones that ended up joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] were military hobbyists. Despite never having seen combat, they had extensively researched military history and procedures and applied that knowledge to their work with the Rebellion.<ref name="RPG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The "Armchair Historian" was one of the original twenty-four character templates used by the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', first published in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition rulebook]].<ref name="RPG1" />
